Trace, implement and test: Largest palindromic substring

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
"""
Take as input a string. Find the longest possible substring from this string which is also a palindrome.

Example
Input: dcodocir

Output" codoc
"""
n = input()
sub = [n[i:j+1] for i in range(len(n)) for j in range(i,len(n))]
print(sub)
mx = 0
for i in sub:
    if i == i[::-1] and len(i) > mx:
        result = i
        mx = len(i)
print(result)
